flow.help: Name, job title and email for each person. Put each person on a new line.
flow.placeholder: e.g. Alex Kim, Head of Sales, alex@example.com

flow.label: What do you sell?
flow.help: Describe your main offer as you would to a new customer. What do they get, and how does it work?

flow.label: What result do your customers get?
Your best results with customers
flow.help: Two or three short stories or links.

flow.label: Links to reviews or testimonial videos
Describe your best customer
flow.help: Age, job, where they live, what they earn, anything that helps us find them.

flow.label: What problems or frustrations make them need you?
What do they want most?
Why do people say no to you?
flow.help: The doubts you hear on sales calls. The ads can answer them before the call.

flow.label: Where should the ads run?
flow.placeholder: e.g. Texas and Florida, or the whole of the UK

flow.label: Have you run paid ads before?
What did you spend, and what did you get back?
flow.help: Rough numbers are fine. Tell us what worked and what did not.

flow.label: Links to your best ads so far
How much do you plan to spend on ads each month?
How should new leads come in?
options: A form on a landing page

flow.label: Can you film videos for the ads?
options: Yes, I can film on my phone
Yes, we have someone who films
No, we need help with this

flow.label: Give us access to your ad account
flow.help: For example, add us as a partner in Meta Business Manager, or as a user in Google Ads. Use the email address in our welcome message.

flow.label: Give us access to your Facebook page and Instagram account
Is ad tracking (the pixel) set up on your website?
Upload your logo, brand colours and any photos or videos to the shared folder we sent you
Is there any access you cannot give us yet?
flow.help: Tell us what it is and why. For example, the login belongs to someone who is away. We will sort it out with you on the onboarding call.

flow.label: What would make the first 90 days a success for you?
flow.help: For example, a number of leads or booked calls each week.

flow.label: Do you have a target cost per lead?
Is there anything you are worried about?
flow.help: For example, something that went wrong with an agency before. We would rather know now.

flow.label: Anything else we should know before the onboarding call?

done.heading: That's everything. Thank you.
done.blurb: Your answers are in. We read them before your onboarding call, so the call starts with your business and not with questions you have already answered.

next.heading: What happens next
items: We read your answers and prepare for the onboarding call.
On the call we check the ad account access together and go through any answer you were not sure about.
Then we write the first ad scripts and send them to you to check.
